description: Routes eight inputs to eight outputs and shifts which input arrives at which output

params.text: Shifts the inputs around the outputs in whole steps, 0 to 7
Sets how many of the inputs are in the rotation, 1 to 8 with 8 by default; outputs past that count repeat the cycle

inputs.text: One of the eight signals being rotated; inputs numbered above the Stages setting are unused
Adds to the rotation, a volt per step
Adds to the stage count, a volt per stage

outputs.text: Carries one of the inputs, picked by the Rotate setting; with Rotate at 0 each output carries the input of the same number
